fact_text: Even with all refineries at full throughput under normal conditions, about 50% of Pakistan's diesel demand would be imported and about 70% of petrol demand, the interviewee said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)

fact_text: At the interview date, Pakistan's refineries were not running at full throughput for several reasons, which the interviewee said pushed imports above normal levels.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)

fact_text: Pakistan's refineries produce a large share of furnace oil because their units are old and not upgraded to make cleaner diesel and petrol, the interviewee said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)

fact_text: Independent power producers that ran on furnace oil have largely shut down because furnace oil became more expensive than other fuel options, the interviewee said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)

fact_text: In 2024, smuggled Iranian diesel and petrol, including solvent-form product, undercut local refiners because it was cheaper, though its quality was very poor, the interviewee said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)

fact_text: Petroleum policy says local refinery output is lifted first and imports are allowed only to cover any deficit, but extra imports are sometimes permitted, which hurts local refinery output.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)

fact_text: Attock Refinery is located in Rawalpindi and is Pakistan's oldest refinery, though the interviewee said it has been upgraded regularly on a four-to-five-year cycle.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)

fact_text: Attock Refinery is the second-oldest refinery in the wider regional market and completed 100 years of history about two years before the interview, the interviewee said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)

fact_text: On the interview date, Attock Refinery produced Euro III-grade diesel, and the interviewee said no Pakistani refinery was producing Euro V-grade fuel.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)

fact_text: Euro III diesel allows up to 350 ppm of sulphur, the interviewee said, which is the baseline that Pakistani refiners are producing against.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)

fact_text: Euro V diesel allows only 10 ppm of sulphur, down from 350 ppm under Euro III, and the interviewee cited this cut as the environmental gain from refinery upgrades.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)

fact_text: The brown-field refinery upgrade policy had a first draft in December 2019, and the interviewee said the talks went on for more than five years before approval.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)

fact_text: The brown-field refinery upgrade policy was approved in August 2023 and then re-approved by cabinet in February 2024 after some points had been left open.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)

fact_text: A green-field refinery policy was approved before the brown-field policy, yet the interviewee said only talk of large projects has followed, such as a USD 10 billion and a USD 12 billion refinery.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)

fact_text: After cabinet re-approval, the company told the gas and oil regulator OGRA it was ready to sign the upgrade agreement, but the signing ceremony, to be chaired by the Prime Minister, kept being postponed.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)

fact_text: The 2025 budget fully exempted petroleum products from sales tax, so refiners could not pass sales tax paid on inputs into prices that the government sets on a fortnightly basis.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)

fact_text: Refiners normally recover sales tax on chemicals, raw materials and services through output prices, but a fixed government price formula means input sales tax that cannot be recovered becomes a direct cost.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)

fact_text: The interviewee cited an increase of about 35 billion in industry costs from the petroleum sales-tax exemption, with the currency not stated in the interview.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)

fact_text: The IMF reportedly said upgrade investment would attract the full 18% sales tax rather than a lower rate such as 2-3%, the interviewee said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)

fact_text: If the 18% sales tax applied to upgrade investment, the interviewee said, petroleum product prices would rise by about 50 rupees per litre, which is why the IMF route was rejected.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)

fact_text: The IMF reportedly suggested cutting the petroleum levy by 50 rupees per litre so consumers would not be affected, but the government did not take up the proposal, the interviewee said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)

fact_text: Petroleum levy revenue goes to the federal government, which the interviewee said explains its reluctance to cut the levy to fund the sales tax on refinery upgrades.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)

fact_text: The Inland Freight Equalisation Margin compensation covers only one year with no written government commitment to continue it, which the interviewee said makes multi-year upgrade projects unbankable.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)

fact_text: A refinery upgrade takes about four to five years of construction and studies, so a subsidy committed for a single year cannot support the financing, the interviewee said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)

fact_text: Policy resets every two to three years deter investors because refinery projects need about 10 to 12 years to pay back, the interviewee said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)

fact_text: The interviewee proposed a stability clause in new agreements so that major policy changes cannot make upgrade projects unviable during their construction period.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)

fact_text: India's refinery upgrade policy of 2000, with a 25-year horizon, reached its targets by 2016-17, making Indian refineries among the most modern, the interviewee said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)

fact_text: Pakistan's refinery-governing petroleum policy dates from 1997, and the interviewee said a new refinery policy drafted to replace it has also not been approved.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)

fact_text: India gave refiners protection in the early stages and withdrew it gradually once they could add value and compete globally, the interviewee said, as a model for Pakistan.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)

fact_text: The 2023 incentive policy was backed by a third-party study of refiners' claimed incentive needs, which the interviewee said showed minimum support was needed for projects to be feasible.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)

fact_text: The interviewee argued that refineries, like autos and steel, need some protection because Middle East rivals have structural cost advantages, otherwise domestic refining cannot operate.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)

fact_text: Pakistani refiners pay about 40% income tax, while Middle East rivals pay almost no income tax, the interviewee said, which widens the cost gap between them.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)

fact_text: Middle East rivals face hardly any customs duty on chemicals, spare parts or capital goods, the interviewee said, unlike Pakistani refiners.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)

fact_text: No country wants to depend fully on imported refined products, the interviewee argued, so Pakistan has to keep domestic refining, which needs policy support to survive.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)

fact_text: At its peak, smuggled Iranian product met more than 30% of Pakistan's total fuel demand, the interviewee said after the company's own calculation.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)

fact_text: At peak smuggling, government revenue losses from lost petroleum levy, customs duty and other taxes exceeded 1 billion USD, the interviewee said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)

fact_text: Smuggled Iranian fuel reached well beyond Balochistan, and a company survey found more than 26 outlets around Rawalpindi selling it.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)

fact_text: Smuggling has come under some control, the interviewee said, through government action and digitisation of the fuel supply chain, and the Iran-Israel conflict may also have helped.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)

fact_text: The interviewee said poverty in border areas does not justify fuel smuggling and that its scale makes it a national issue, not only a cross-border trade matter.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)

fact_text: Oil marketing company margins were meant to be linked to inflation and reset each year under an agreed formula, but they had not changed for two years as of the interview date.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)

fact_text: The government wants tracers on every pump and truck linked to a central control room, which the interviewee said needs about 50 billion in investment across oil marketing companies.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)

fact_text: Digitisation spending combined with frozen margins could leave oil marketing companies unable to cover normal operating costs, the interviewee argued.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)

fact_text: The government had not committed to raising oil marketing margins, and a margin proposal was reportedly taken to the ECC without being shared with industry first.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)

fact_text: A petroleum levy and a carbon support levy on furnace oil raised its local sales price by about 80%, cutting local sales to near zero, the interviewee said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)

fact_text: The interviewee argued the furnace-oil levy hits domestic sales but not exports, so refiners lose margin on exported volumes without any gain in government revenue.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)

fact_text: Pakistan's high-sulphur furnace oil (HSFO) cannot be used directly for marine shipping, so it is exported and converted to low-sulphur fuel by foreign buyers.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)

fact_text: Furnace oil exports earn a negative margin because buyers pay less for high-sulphur product, and exporters also bear extra transport and storage costs, the interviewee said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)

fact_text: Attock Refinery makes low-sulphur furnace oil (LSFO), unlike other Pakistani refiners that make high-sulphur furnace oil (HSFO), the interviewee said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)

fact_text: Attock's low-sulphur furnace oil exports earn only a thin margin, but the interviewee said they keep the refinery running, which is better than a shutdown.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)

fact_text: Attock Refinery says it still runs on 100% indigenous crude sourced from Pakistan's own fields, the interviewee said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)

fact_text: Because northern crude supply is lower, Attock Refinery was running at about 65 to 70% of capacity, which the interviewee said cuts throughput and profit.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)

fact_text: The company asked government to divert about 5,000 barrels per day of Sindh condensate, which is exported from Pakistan at low prices, to Attock Refinery instead.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)

fact_text: Transporting crude costs about half as much as moving refined diesel or petrol, which the interviewee gave as the reason to move Sindh crude to northern refineries.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)

fact_text: The condensate diversion proposal won ECC approval, but a minutes error forced re-approval, which took six more months, the interviewee said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)

fact_text: After re-approval, transport rates lapsed during a further six-month wait, forcing a re-tender and a second loss of the transport contract, with a summary still pending about six months later.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)

fact_text: Attock has finished feasibility and basic engineering studies costing millions of dollars and says it is ready to start the upgrade once policy is settled.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)

fact_text: The national refinery upgrade programme requires about 6 billion USD of investment across the refineries, the interviewee said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)

fact_text: Upgrading refineries could save the country about 1 billion USD a year in foreign exchange by cutting imports of diesel and petrol, the interviewee said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)

fact_text: Each year of delay in implementing the refinery upgrade policy costs the country about 1 billion USD in foreign exchange, the interviewee said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)

fact_text: The reporter cited an expected foreign direct investment of 5 to 6 billion USD tied to the refinery upgrade programme, a figure the interviewee did not dispute.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)

fact_text: The interviewee's last meeting with the petroleum minister was around October 2025, when he was told the government was working on the sales-tax issue, with no outcome since.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)

fact_text: The Special Investment Facilitation Council has taken up the refinery policy several times without resolving it, and the interviewee said it held no meeting on the issue in the two months before the interview.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)

fact_text: The former petroleum minister, interviewed in December 2024, reportedly said the industry was unwilling to give up some margin, which he said could resolve the policy issue.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)

fact_text: The interviewee said officials tend to consult only companies they are comfortable with, and argued that industry and independent experts should be involved from the start of policy design.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)

fact_text: The interviewee said he does not believe an import lobby is deliberately blocking refinery upgrades, although some people argue that it is.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)

fact_text: A restriction on remitting profits abroad, imposed about two years before the interview, made foreign refinery investors uneasy, which the interviewee said deters new investment.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)

fact_text: Foreign companies such as Shell have left Pakistan, and the interviewee said memoranda of understanding keep being signed without new foreign investment following.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)

fact_text: Refiners gave the government a 20-year account of deemed duty paid on diesel alongside their own upgrade investments, the interviewee said, in answer to the question of why they had not upgraded.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)

fact_text: Attock's majority shareholders are foreign, but its management is 100% Pakistani, and the interviewee said the shareholders have never rejected an upgrade project the company proposed.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)

fact_text: The Attock group holds upstream oil and gas, Attock Refinery, National Refinery and marketing businesses, and has started investing in solar.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)

fact_text: The interviewee said there are no plans to exit the refinery business, though a cement company in the Attock group was reported as being on sale.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)

fact_text: The interviewee said Attock is ready to lead a national refinery upgrade programme once government policy is settled, and that the company has prepared for it.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'USD 6 Billion Investment Stalled Amid Pakistan Refinery Upgrade Delays | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-11)
